title: 2026 data on health claim rejection
takeaways: Insurers repudiated about 8% of health claims in FY25, down from 11%.
₹26,000 crore of health claims were repudiated in FY24.
33% of surveyed claimants got partial approval for invalid reasons.
86.88% of cashless pre-authorisations were decided within 1 hour.
TPAs settled 69% of FY25 health claims by number.
